name: Verificate Guard
description: The trust layer for OpenClaw. Gates the final answer (and, opt-in, code-writing tool calls) through Verificate's reality gates + frontier review before you trust it. Fail-open, free to try.

token.description: Optional Verificate API token. Omit for the free tier (25 validations/machine).

gateCode.description: Gate final answers that contain code.

gateProse.description: Also gate prose answers as documents.

guardToolWrites.description: Validate code inside write/patch tool calls and require approval on a reject.

maxRevisions.description: Extra model passes to request when an answer is rejected.

timeoutMs.description: Per-validation network budget; on timeout the guard fails open.
